# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility for safely rendering a user‑submitted blog post. """ import html from typing import Final # Example template – replace with the actual format used in your project. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The main body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML ready for rendering. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError(f"headline must be a string, got {type(headline).__name__}") if not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError(f"text must be a string, got {type(text).__name__}") # Escape user input to prevent XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Use the template to construct the final HTML. formatted = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted.strip()
